description: A vector oscillator: it runs a point round the outline of a shape and gives its position as a pair of voltages, tracing a circle until an SVG is pasted in

params.text: Sets how many times a second the outline is traced, from about 16Hz to 1046Hz
Scales the shape, from nothing at 0 to 1.2 times its stored size
Turns the shape, reaching half a turn one way at one end of its travel and half a turn the other way at the other end

inputs.text: Adds to the trace rate at 1V per octave
Adds to the scale, a tenth per volt, with the total clamped between 0 and 10
Turns the shape further, 5V giving half a turn

outputs.text: The horizontal position of the tracing point, one channel per shape in the SVG
The vertical position of the tracing point, one channel per shape in the SVG

notes: with no SVG pasted, one channel traces a circle of ±5V.
the pasted shape is saved with the patch and comes back when the patch is loaded.
the shapes are scaled together, so their positions relative to each other are kept: the wider of the two dimensions spans ±5V before the SCALE controls and the other spans proportionally less.
the outline is sampled by arc length rather than by drawing order, so the point travels at an even speed all the way round however the curves are drawn.
each of the three knobs draws a gold arc from its own position round to where its CV input has moved it.
menu: Paste SVG from clipboard — reads an SVG from the system clipboard and traces its outlines, up to sixteen of them, one per output channel
Clear SVG — throws the pasted shape away and returns to the circle

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
